name: ThuillierTraderOption
summary: This is an empty MQL5 Expert Advisor template generated by MetaQuotes with all standard event handler functions declared but none implemented. It contains no trading logic, no indicator calls, and no parameters, serving only as a skeleton for future development.
summary_zh: 这是一个由MetaQuotes生成的空MQ5 EA模板，声明了所有标准事件处理函数但均未实现。它不包含任何交易逻辑、指标调用或参数，仅作为未来开发的骨架框架。
strategy_analysis: 该EA完全没有任何策略实现，所有事件处理函数（OnTick、OnTimer、OnTrade、OnTradeTransaction等）内部均为空注释占位符。没有定义任何入场条件或出场条件，OnTick函数中没有任何价格分析或信号生成逻辑。仓位管理完全缺失，没有任何手数计算、止损止盈设置或持仓检查。资金管理方面同样为空白，没有风险比例控制、最大持仓限制或资金保护机制。OnTimer函数仅设置了60秒定时器但未执行任何操作，OnTradeTransaction也没有处理任何交易事务。整体而言，这只是一个IDE自动生成的脚手架代码，不具备任何可运行的交易功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has absolutely no strategy implementation; all event handler functions (OnTick, OnTimer, OnTrade, OnTradeTransaction, etc.) contain only empty comment placeholders. There are no entry or exit conditions defined, and the OnTick function contains no price analysis or signal generation logic whatsoever. Position management is entirely absent, with no lot size calculation, stop-loss/take-profit configuration, or position checking. Money management is similarly blank, lacking risk ratio controls, maximum position limits, or equity protection mechanisms. The OnTimer function sets a 60-second timer but performs no operations, and OnTradeTransaction does not process any trade transactions. Overall, this is merely an IDE-generated scaffold with no runnable trading functionality at all.
pros: 代码结构清晰，包含所有MQ5标准事件处理函数框架
使用EventSetTimer/EventKillTimer正确管理定时器生命周期
遵循MetaQuotes官方编码规范和注释风格
pros_en: Clean code structure with all standard MQL5 event handler function frameworks included
Proper timer lifecycle management using EventSetTimer/EventKillTimer
Follows MetaQuotes official coding conventions and comment style
cons: 完全没有任何交易逻辑实现，只是一个空壳模板
没有任何输入参数供用户配置策略
缺少错误处理、日志记录和状态监控功能
cons_en: Absolutely no trading logic implemented; it is just an empty shell template
No input parameters available for users to configure any strategy
Missing error handling, logging, and status monitoring functionality
improvements: 添加核心交易策略逻辑，至少在OnTick中实现基本的信号检测和订单发送
增加风险管理参数（止损、止盈、最大持仓等）作为可配置输入
improvements_en: Add core trading strategy logic, at minimum implementing basic signal detection and order sending in OnTick
Add risk management parameters (stop-loss, take-profit, max positions, etc.) as configurable inputs

risk_points: 由于没有任何交易功能，不存在实际交易风险
如果用户误以为该EA已实现交易逻辑而部署到实盘，可能产生误操作风险
risk_points_en: Since there is no trading functionality, there is no actual trading risk
If a user mistakenly believes this EA has implemented trading logic and deploys it live, it could lead to misoperation risk
